The 16 English 12/24-word entropy–mnemonic pairs in `english-vectors.json`
are extracted, without changing the strings, from the Trezor reference vectors:
https://github.com/trezor/python-mnemonic/blob/master/vectors.json

Retrieved 2026-10-13. Upstream license is preserved in LICENSE.trezor. The
seed-derivation columns and unsupported 15/18/21-word vectors are omitted
because this application backs up entropy and does not derive wallet seeds.
